title: Derived scalar pullback comparison commutes with shifts
statement: The defining composite consists of three comparison isomorphisms; shift compatibility of each factor and composition gives the inverse composite compatibility. The derived scalar comparison is the canonical construction of [def-sbc-raw-scalar-derived-pullback-iso].

proof.text: Use the proved shift compatibility of the unbounded derived natural-isomorphism and composition comparisons from WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.Shift.ExactFunctor. Restrict each to bounded-below categories: whisker with the fully faithful inclusion, express the comparison using mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompatibility and associators, and reflect CommShift with NatTrans.CommShift.of_whiskerRight. The compatibility comparisons commute with shifts by ObjectProperty.liftCompιIso. Apply these facts to each of the three factors of derivedPullbackIso; CommShift is stable under inverses and composition.
